newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm in light test-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm in light test-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers firm in a light test, compared Thursday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow. Demand uneven, light to moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 69.00-70.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1200 lbs 69.00-70.00.
